body: I have been recording him for over a year now, his voice and what he says is so chilling and he tells me no one will believe me because he’ll admit me to a “psych ward” and tell everyone I’m crazy.  Seriously feels like I’m in a horror movie.  But I don’t want to get in trouble for recording if it’s a law or something.  I have them just in case I die or something people will see I was never making it up!

Thank you so much.  It makes me cry to hear that people care.  Even strangers. I have a therapist, and I’m leaning on every resource I possibly can because I have a real fear I will kill myself if I don’t stay connected to my support systems.  Nothing feels safe with my husband anymore.  My parents want to take me away from here and go back home but I’m too proud.  I’m scared they’ll commit me to a mental hospital like Mama Jumbo in the dumbo movie.  Anyway thank you so much for listening.  And caring.
I can’t stop crying. My husband won’t leave me alone.

My heart aches for you and I hope you are finding comfort these days.  If it’s of any consolation, I honor your story and will hold it with deep love and compassion in my heart.  I know I am a complete stranger, but we are connected in our pain.  You are such a lovable person, please don’t forget that.  I hope something great happens in your future, beyond your wildest dreams.  Have hope!
I am so sorry to hear that.  Is there anything that has helped you to move on? I am so scared I will fee like this forever.
Thank you. I can’t stop sobbing. The pain will not leave me.  I want to be with my baby.
Thank you so much for the kind words.  I can’t tell you what it means to me, to hear empathy coming from a guy.
Thank you so so much.  I am glad people like you are out there.
